The eight-field declaration digest binds id, path, start, end, sha256, category, reason and source_evidence using compact sorted ensure_ascii=true JSON. It does not by itself include the separate source_context_sha256 field. That context hash is explicitly bound here, by the full input hash and by the required actual acceptance/evidence context; it must not be omitted by a consumer.

Admission needs the original full-source context bound through the actual existing prepared acceptance/evidence mechanism, not merely a declared digest or matching historical heading. Any outside-context change or recontextualization as current execution blocks reuse. Whole-source hashing is a context invariant, not permission to mask the whole file.
